Question: How much does Quora pay for 10k viewers?
Answer: Gabriel Okello, Quora does not pay for viewers. Click the link in the footnote to find out about Quora monetization as well as the 25 countries where monetization is possible.[1] Even if you had 10 billion viewers, you would not get paid. Why do you think Quora pays for viewers??? NOTE: Quora has some other ways to make a few pennies for people who write excellent, ORIGINAL English answers in Spaces that some people join and pay to read (it is only enough to buy a small chai or coffee every few weeks), but you live in Africa, and Quora has never paid anyone living in Africa. Also, just to set the record straight, Quora no longer pays anyone for writing questions. For a few years, certain people were invited to participate in the Quora Partner Program (QPP), and they would get paid for asking questions that brought in a lot of advertising revenue. THE QPP ENDED IN SEPTEMBER 2022 FOR ENGLISH, AND IN MARCH 2023 FOR ALL OTHER LANGUAGES. The QPP was no longer needed once Quora introduced the Quora Prompt Generator, a bot that asks questions 24/7 and does not need to be paid.
